This Privacy Policy describes how BikePilot ("the App", "we", "us") handles information when you use the app. BikePilot is developed and published by Sebastian Gasch ("the Developer").

BikePilot is designed to work entirely on your device. We do not operate a backend server, we do not collect analytics, and we do not sell or share your personal data with third parties. The App does not track you across apps or websites owned by other companies.

To provide its core cycling-computer functionality, BikePilot requests access to the following device capabilities. Access is requested only when needed and only with your permission, granted through the standard iOS permission prompts.

rows.text: Measure speed, distance, altitude and grade, and to record your route on the map during a ride.

Sensor readings are processed on your device in real time and stored locally as part of your ride data; BikePilot does not transmit sensor data anywhere.

items.text: We do not use any analytics, advertising, or crash-reporting SDKs.
We do not operate our own servers, and the App does not send your rides, location history, sensor readings, or any other personal data to us or to any third party.
We do not use tracking technologies (as defined by Apple's App Tracking Transparency framework) and do not request tracking permission.
We do not collect or store account information, because BikePilot does not require account creation or sign-in.

runs.text: All ride data (GPS tracks, speed/cadence/heart-rate/temperature readings, settings, and recorded rides) is stored locally on your device using Apple's standard on-device storage mechanisms (
UserDefaults

and local app storage). This data is not synced to iCloud or any other cloud service by the App itself, unless your device's own iCloud device backup includes the App's local data as part of a system-level backup, which is controlled by your iOS Settings, not by BikePilot.

You can delete all locally stored ride data at any time by deleting recorded rides within the App, or by deleting the App from your device, which removes all of its local data in accordance with standard iOS app-deletion behavior.

BikePilot offers an optional auto-renewable subscription ("BikePilot PRO") that unlocks additional features. Subscription purchases, renewals, and restores are handled entirely by Apple's StoreKit and your Apple ID / App Store account. We do not receive or store your payment information — purchase and billing data is processed and retained by Apple in accordance with
Apple's Privacy Policy

BikePilot is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect personal data from children. Because the App does not collect or transmit personal data to us in the first place, no data about any user, including children, is retained by the Developer.

Because all personal data created by using BikePilot (location history, ride data, sensor readings) remains on your device and is never transmitted to us, you retain full control over it at all times: you can view, export, or delete it directly within the App or by removing the App. As we do not hold any of your personal data on our systems, there is no separate data-access, correction, or deletion request process to submit to us for that data.
If you have questions about this Policy or how the App handles device permissions, you may contact us using the details below.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, for example to reflect new App features. The "Last updated" date at the top of this document indicates when it was last revised. Continued use of the App after a change constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
